pages.text:
Melts rock into lava with an electric arc: cobblestone or stone gives 250 mB, netherrack 500 mB and a magma block 1,000 mB. It costs 50 FE per mB at 100 FE/t, so a bucket of lava takes 50,000 FE.
The lava leaves through Output faces (the bottom by default) into conduits, tanks or a Geothermal Plant. Put a Geothermal Plant straight under it and it fills itself. The internal tank holds 4,000 mB; when it is full the melter waits.
# Is it worth it?
A Geothermal Plant feeding a Thermoelectric Plant turns a bucket of lava back into about 79,000 FE, so a melter loop pays about 60% more than it costs. Upgrades on either side widen the margin.
- Speed upgrades melt faster and draw more FE per tick; Energy upgrades cut the FE per bucket.
